defs.def: to be obvious or easy to see 明摆着；显而易见

ex.s: That evening, she sat in her room, staring into space.
ex.t: 那天晚上，她坐在房间里，凝视着虚空。

ex.s: One August afternoon, I sat in my kitchen staring at a glass vase that hadn’t seen daylight since my wedding.
ex.t: 不久前的一个寒冷冬夜，有个青少年想要更多屏幕时间，而家长拒绝了。

ex.s: Kevin stared at the man at their front door.
Staring at the bookcases in my study, packed with so many great books that had remained unread, I heard a loud voice in my head — “Shame on you!
ex.t: 如何在家庭中实践零浪费生活方式。

ex.s: I just stared at it and started to ___8___.
ex.t: 我只是盯着它，然后开始____。

ex.s: For almost a year I struggled on, constantly staring at this wall that faced me.
ex.t: 近一年来我一直在挣扎， constantly 盯着面前的那堵墙。

ex.s: I can’t just sit there and stare at a TV all day.
ex.t: 我不能整天坐在那里盯着电视看。

ex.s: However, what my children want to do after school is pick up a screen — any screen — and stare at it for hours.
ex.t: 如今的孩子平均每天花四个半小时看电视和使用互联网。

ex.s: As the night wore on，people began to close their eyes，but the seats were so uncomfortable that only a very heavy sleeper could manage to get any____3____．The woman looked over at the man．He was still staring at her．She looked back at him with fire in her eyes．I was beginning to get____4____，too．
ex.t: 夜深了人们开始闭上眼睛但座位很不舒服只有睡得很沉的人才能____3____睡着．那位女士看向男士．他还在盯着她看．她用愤怒的眼神回望他．我也开始变得____4____不安了．

ex.s: A son of immigrants, Chris stared learning English a little over three years ago.
ex.t: 作为移民的儿子，克里斯在三年多一点前才开始学习英语。

ex.s: The museum was free． We entered， excited． A group of people sitting in the hall stopped talking and stared at us．
ex.t: 三十年后，一位女士在公共场所走近我。"打扰一下，你很久以前是否进入过一个住宅，以为那是麦克奈博物馆？"

ex.s: （3）How did the author feel about being stared at by the people in the hall？
ex.t: B．她太心烦了以至于不能在真正的博物馆待太久。

ex.s: A comprehensive study of 4, 500 children conducted by the National Institutes of Health in 2018 shows that children who spent more than seven hours a day staring at screens showed evidence of premature thinning of their brain's cortex-the outer layer that processes sensory information.
ex.t: 只有当我们长期跟踪他们，我们才会看到是否有与我们在这张快照中所看到的差异相关的结果，"盖亚·道林博士说。

ex.s: With water falling off it thick, brown hair, the bear stared back at me.
ex.t: 那头熊披着厚厚的棕色毛发，水从上面滴落，它盯着我看。

ex.s: People would stare at me because I was “big” and I hated the way I looked.
ex.t: 人们会盯着我看，因为我'块头大'，我讨厌自己的样子。

ex.s: They stared back, their blank faces giving no clue as to what they would say next.
ex.t: 他们回盯着她，他们茫然的脸没有给出任何线索，不知道接下来会说什么。

ex.s: They stared back and their faces showed no clue that could help her know what they were going to say next.
ex.t: 他们回盯着她，他们的脸上没有透露出任何迹象，能让她知道他们接下来要说什么。
